slides.headline: How to use *Higgsfield AI*, and what you really get for free

slides.heading: 1. What is *free*
paras: No free trial. The free tier gives a small set of models and no credits.
Paid plans add monthly credits, more models and Unlimited access to some models on mid and top plans.

slides.heading: 2. Pick a model, *write one shot*
paras: Open AI Video, press Create Video Now and choose Kling, Seedance, Veo or another model.
Describe one shot: subject, movement, camera, light. Then set the length.

slides.heading: 3. Read the *Generate button*
paras: It shows the exact credit cost before you confirm. Asking for 4 results costs 4 times.
Failed runs usually refund. Check Manage Account, then Usage.

slides.heading: 4. Use *Unlimited* where you can
paras: If your plan covers a model, an Unlimited toggle appears. Turn it on to spend no credits.
It only works on higgsfield.ai, never through MCP, CLI or other tools.

site_article.summary: Higgsfield lets you generate images and video with many models in one place, but its free tier offers only a few models and no credits. This guide covers the free tier, your first video step by step, and how credits, refunds and Unlimited access work.

site_article.seo_description: How to use Higgsfield AI step by step: what the free tier includes, how to make your first video, two prompts to copy, and how credits and Unlimited work.
site_article.answer_summary: To use Higgsfield AI, sign in at higgsfield.ai, open AI Video, pick a model, describe one shot and check the credit cost on the Generate button. The free tier has no credits and only a small set of models, and there is no free trial.

paragraphs.text: How to use Higgsfield AI comes down to two things: picking the right model for each shot, and watching your credits. Higgsfield is a web platform that puts many image and video models in one place, including Kling, Veo, Seedance, Wan and MiniMax for video, and Nano Banana, Soul, FLUX, GPT Image and Seedream for images.

The short answer on price: you can use Higgsfield without paying, but only a small set of models, and no credits come with it. Higgsfield's own help center says there is no free trial. Everything below tells you what you can do for free, how to make your first video, and how not to burn credits by accident.
What you get on Higgsfield for free

Higgsfield says you can generate on the free tier with a limited set of models and upgrade later. Paid plans add a monthly credit allowance, access to more models and the ability to run several generations at once. Mid and top plans also include Unlimited access to selected models, which means generations on those models cost no credits for a set period.

Some plans also include a one-time pool of free generations on specific models. Higgsfield names Soul 2.0 and Soul Cinema as examples. These free generations do not renew, and each plan's exact pool is listed under Unlimited & Free Gens on its card on the Pricing page.

A third-party guide from Layer3Labs, updated November 9, 2026, says free output carries a watermark and treats the free tier as a demo rather than a way to work. The Higgsfield help pages used for this guide do not mention a watermark, so check your own export before you post anything.
How to make your first Higgsfield video

paragraphs.title: 1. Open the video workspace
paragraphs.text: Sign in at higgsfield.ai and open AI Video. The Create Video Now button takes you into the video workspace with a model already selected.

paragraphs.title: 2. Pick a model
paragraphs.text: Choose a model from the list. The video page shows Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.0, Wan 2.7, Kling o1, MiniMax H3, Veo 3.1 and Kling 2.6. On the free tier you only see the small set of models Higgsfield allows there.

paragraphs.title: 3. Write the shot
paragraphs.text: Type a description of the shot into the prompt box and set the length. Describe one shot, not a whole story: who or what is in frame, what moves, where the camera is, and the light.

paragraphs.title: Prompt 1: A simple product shot
paragraphs.text: Slow push-in on a [product] standing on a wet stone table at night, soft rain in the background, warm light from one side, shallow depth of field, 8 seconds.

paragraphs.title: Prompt 2: A person in motion
paragraphs.text: Handheld tracking shot of a [person description] walking through a busy street market at sunset, camera follows from behind, then circles to the front as they stop and look up.

paragraphs.title: 4. Check the cost, then generate
paragraphs.text: Look at the Generate button before you click. Higgsfield shows the exact credit cost there before you confirm. If you ask for 2, 3 or 4 results at once, each one is charged separately, and the total appears on the same button.

paragraphs.title: 5. Use references when you need control
paragraphs.text: The video page lists first and last frame references, editing a video you upload, and motion control from a reference video. Cinema Studio adds a choice of camera body, lens and focal length, and lets you stack up to three camera movements.

Draft on a cheaper model and run only the final shot on a premium one. Layer3Labs suggests drafting on Kling or Seedance and finishing on Veo 3.1, and planning two to three attempts for each important shot.
How Higgsfield credits work

Credits pay for images, videos, re-rolls and upscaling. Browsing costs nothing. The cost depends on the model, the resolution and the length, which is why the Generate button is the only number to trust.

Subscription credits reset every billing cycle, and unused ones expire at renewal. Credit Packs and Auto-Refill credits expire 90 days after purchase. Higgsfield spends your subscription credits first, then the others in order of expiry, soonest first.

Failed generations usually return their credits within a few minutes, though Higgsfield says some models may not refund. To check, open your avatar, then Manage Account, then Usage. The log shows every deduction and refund with the model and the time.

One trap: Unlimited and free generations only work on the higgsfield.ai website. Generations through MCP, the CLI, Canvas, Supercomputer or other automated tools always cost credits, even on a model that is unlimited on the site.

If your plan covers a model with Unlimited access, the generation panel shows an Unlimited toggle. Turn it on to stop spending credits. Turn it off and you pay credits, but the job runs in the faster priority queue.
Before you pay for Higgsfield

Higgsfield's paid plans cost less per month when billed yearly. Upgrades apply right away with a prorated charge. Refunds are available within 7 days of the first purchase if no credits were used, with a service fee of up to 6%, and renewals are not refundable. Prices are on the Pricing page, not in the help center.

Where Higgsfield falls short: credits go fast once you start re-rolling, and Layer3Labs warns that colors, logos and labels can drift between takes, so a character or product may not look the same from clip to clip. Higgsfield is strongest as a single place to try many video models side by side, and weakest as a cheap way to produce a lot of finished footage.
Keep your source photos and the prompts that worked in a document outside Higgsfield. When you need a new version of the same shot later, you can start from the exact settings instead of guessing.
